Name: (Arknights) Shu Outfit and Hair
Author: Circuit4
Description:
I love Arknights and always wondered if anyone else made a mod like this one and couldn't find one on Nexus, so I decided to make one myself. Just so everyone knows, I'm not an artist and this is my first mod so please forgive me for any mistakes.

This mod includes:
1 Hair: Shu Hair
1 Shirt: Shu Shirt
2 Pants: Shu Pants 1, Shu Pants 2
1 Accessory: Shu Horns

I am not good at art or animating, so the movement animations for the pants are pretty bad but it was the best I could do. If anyone wants to touch it up feel free to message me and send me the files and I'll update the mod and I can add you to the credits.

Also, I used the baggy sleeves from this mod:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32523
